observations.name: history-key-thread-only
observations.current: getHistoryKey returns chatId:threadId when threadId exists and chatId otherwise
observations.gap: group replies without thread_id do not fall back to root_id
observations.target: thread_id first, then root_id, then chat_id

observations.name: topic-group-compatibility
observations.current: message routing explicitly branches on p2p and group only
observations.gap: topic_group is not an explicit compatible group route
observations.target: topic_group uses thread_id-first lane and reply routing

observations.name: parent-root-reply-target
observations.current: group replies use parent_id when present and root_id otherwise; p2p uses base send
observations.target: parent_id changes only the reply target and never the lane

observations.name: reaction-card-open
observations.current: successful immediate response-card open removes the typing reaction
observations.gap: card open is projection state, not delivery settlement
observations.target: presence remains active through card open and progress

observations.name: reaction-120-seconds
observations.current: TYPING_TIMEOUT is 120 seconds and schedules removeTypingIndicator
observations.gap: elapsed time is used as a normal presence finish condition

observations.name: projection-timeout-terminalization
observations.current: queued/main projection timeouts set local state.status to failed and render retry text
observations.gap: local projection/observation state is presented as Runtime evidence

observations.name: durable-inbound-dedupe
observations.current: event and message identities deduplicate durably and payload fingerprints are stored
observations.gap: identity values are not namespaced by adapter/account/eventType and no laneSequence is assigned
observations.target: namespaced dual identity and one post-dedupe laneSequence
